prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in San Francisco?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” digital marketing agency in San Francisco — the right agency depends on your goals, budget, industry, channels, and whether you need strategy, creative, performance (paid), SEO, content, or full-service support.

To help you find the best fit, here’s a quick guide plus next steps I can take for you.

What matters when choosing an agency
- Core services: Do you need SEO, paid ads (PPC), social, content, email, CRO, creative/design, or full-funnel demand gen? Pick agencies that specialize in the channels you care about.  
- Industry experience: Prior work in your vertical (SaaS, e‑commerce, healthcare, fintech, etc.) shortens ramp time and improves strategy fit.  
- Size & bandwidth: Startups often prefer smaller, nimble agencies; enterprises usually need larger teams with process and scale.  
- Track record & case studies: Look for measurable results (CPL, CAC, revenue growth) and client names or testimonials.  
- Reporting & transparency: Request sample dashboards, reporting cadence, and KPIs.  
- Team & point of contact: Who will do the work vs. who pitches? Ask for bios of the actual team.  
- Pricing & contract terms: Monthly retainer vs. project vs. performance fees; minimum terms and exit clauses.  
- Cultural fit & communication: Time zone overlap, meeting frequency, and style matter.  
- Tools & tech stack: Which analytics, CRM, ad, or automation tools do they use, and do those fit your stack?

Where to find and vet agencies
- Directories with reviews: Clutch.co, G2, UpCity — filter by “San Francisco,” service, and client size.  
- LinkedIn: check company pages and client posts.  
- Google reviews and local networks: Meetup groups, YC founder forums, Slack communities.  
- Ask for references and speak to past or current clients.

Quick vetting questions to ask an agency
- Have you worked with companies like ours? Can you show results (CPL, MQLs, revenue)?  
- What would a 90‑day plan for us look like? What are the expected outcomes?  
- Who will be on the team and how many hours per week?  
- How do you measure and report success? Can I see a sample dashboard?  
- What’s your pricing model and minimum engagement? How are additional ad spends handled?  
- Can you provide client references and a recent case study?

Typical budgets (very general)
- Small business / early-stage startups: $2k–8k/month retainers (or project-based) + ad spend.  
- Mid-market / growth stage: $8k–30k/month + ad spend.  
- Enterprise: $30k+/month + larger ad budgets and multi-channel programs.

If you want, I can:
- Recommend 3–5 San Francisco agencies tailored to your needs.
- Produce email templates and interview questions to send to shortlisted agencies.
Tell me: your marketing goals, primary channels you want to use, monthly marketing budget (including ad spend), company stage (startup, SMB, enterprise), and industry — and I’ll build a short, prioritized list.
